[HLD_CruiseControl_v1.0 v1.0 | 1 Introduction | p.1-1]
This document describes the high-level design of the cruise control subsystem on the vehicle ECU. Intended readers are system architects, software developers, integration engineers and test engineers.

[HLD_CruiseControl_v1.0 v1.0 | 2 Architecture overview | p.1-1]
The subsystem consists of 5 software components in the application layer. Components communicate through ports typed by port interfaces, connected by the RTE.

[HLD_CruiseControl_v1.0 v1.0 | 2 Architecture overview > 2.1 Component catalogue | p.1-1]
| Component | Kind | Runnable | Period (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|
| SWC_WheelSpeedSensor | Sensor-actuator SWC | Rn_ReadWheelSpeed | 10 |
| SWC_VehicleSpeedCalc | Application SWC | Rn_CalcVehicleSpeed | 10 |
| SWC_CruiseControl | Application SWC | Rn_CruiseControlStep | 20 |
| SWC_EngineControl | Application SWC | Rn_ApplyThrottle | 10 |
| SWC_DisplayCluster | Application SWC | Rn_UpdateDisplay | 100 |

[HLD_CruiseControl_v1.0 v1.0 | 3 Software component descriptions > 3.1 SWC_WheelSpeedSensor | p.2-2]
Reads the wheel speed pulses through the ECU abstraction layer and publishes the filtered wheel speed to the application layer.

| Port | Dir | Interface | Interface type | Data element | Data type | Unit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pp_WheelSpeed | P | If_WheelSpeed | Sender-Receiver | wheelSpeed | uint16 | km/h |

Runnable Rn_ReadWheelSpeed is triggered every 10 ms by a timing event. It writes wheelSpeed through Pp_WheelSpeed.

[HLD_CruiseControl_v1.0 v1.0 | 3 Software component descriptions > 3.2 SWC_VehicleSpeedCalc | p.2-2]
Calculates the vehicle speed and the longitudinal acceleration from the wheel speed and publishes both values.

| Port | Dir | Interface | Interface type | Data element | Data type | Unit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rp_WheelSpeed | R | If_WheelSpeed | Sender-Receiver | wheelSpeed | uint16 | km/h |
| Pp_VehicleSpeed | P | If_VehicleSpeed | Sender-Receiver | vehicleSpeed | uint16 | km/h |
| Pp_VehicleAccel | P | If_VehicleAccel | Sender-Receiver | vehicleAccel | sint16 | m/s2 |

Runnable Rn_CalcVehicleSpeed is triggered every 10 ms by a timing event. It reads wheelSpeed through Rp_WheelSpeed. It writes vehicleSpeed through Pp_VehicleSpeed. It writes vehicleAccel through Pp_VehicleAccel.

[HLD_CruiseControl_v1.0 v1.0 | 3 Software component descriptions > 3.3 SWC_CruiseControl | p.3-3]
Holds the driver set speed. It consumes the vehicle speed from the Vehicle Speed Calculator (SWC_VehSpeedCalc) and the brake status, and requests throttle from the engine control.

| Port | Dir | Interface | Interface type | Data element | Data type | Unit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rp_VehicleSpeed | R | If_VehicleSpeed | Sender-Receiver | vehicleSpeed | uint16 | km/h |
| Rp_BrakeStatus | R | If_BrakeStatus | Sender-Receiver | brakeActive | boolean | - |
| Pp_ThrottleRequest | P | If_ThrottleRequest | Sender-Receiver | throttlePct | uint8 | % |

Runnable Rn_CruiseControlStep is triggered every 20 ms by a timing event. It reads vehicleSpeed through Rp_VehicleSpeed. It reads brakeActive through Rp_BrakeStatus. It writes throttlePct through Pp_ThrottleRequest.

[HLD_CruiseControl_v1.0 v1.0 | 3 Software component descriptions > 3.4 SWC_EngineControl | p.3-3]
Converts the throttle request into an actuator command for the electronic throttle.

| Port | Dir | Interface | Interface type | Data element | Data type | Unit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rp_ThrottleRequest | R | If_ThrottleRequest | Client-Server | throttlePct | uint8 | % |

Runnable Rn_ApplyThrottle is triggered every 10 ms by a timing event. It reads throttlePct through Rp_ThrottleRequest.

[HLD_CruiseControl_v1.0 v1.0 | 3 Software component descriptions > 3.5 SWC_DisplayCluster | p.4-4]
Shows the current vehicle speed to the driver on the instrument cluster.

| Port | Dir | Interface | Interface type | Data element | Data type | Unit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rp_VehicleSpeed | R | If_VehicleSpeed | Sender-Receiver | vehicleSpeed | uint8 | mph |

Runnable Rn_UpdateDisplay is triggered every 100 ms by a timing event. It reads vehicleSpeed through Rp_VehicleSpeed.

[HLD_CruiseControl_v1.0 v1.0 | 4 Revision history | p.4-4]
| Version | Date | Change |
|---|---|---|
| 1.0 | 2026-09-01 | Initial release |
